caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The chair is viewed directly from the front, displaying four horizontal slats across the backrest and two vertical posts topped with finials. The chair’s legs and arms are cylindrical, with the front legs featuring turned detailing just below the arms. The arms of the chair extend horizontally and are supported by additional vertical posts. The seat is made of woven material, arranged in a diagonal pattern that converges at the center. The wood of the chair is depicted in warm brown tones, and the woven seat is rendered in light brown, providing a contrast with the study linear design of the wooden frame. There are no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Chair, Pine with Rush Seat
